name: reponizer
title: Reponizer
description: Organize, audit, and sync a structured git repository folder (git-get style host/owner/repo layout).
author: lonetis

commands.name: search-repos
commands.title: Search Repositories
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Browse, inspect, and manage all local git repositories.

commands.name: clone-repo
commands.title: Clone Repository
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Clone a repository into the structured repos folder.

commands.name: fetch-all
commands.title: Fetch All Repositories
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Run git fetch in every repository and refresh their status.

commands.name: pull-all
commands.title: Pull All Repositories
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Fast-forward pull every clean repository and refresh their status.

commands.name: export-repos
commands.title: Export Repository List
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Export the repository list to a JSON file for mirroring on another machine.

commands.name: import-repos
commands.title: Import Repository List
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Import a repository list and clone missing repositories into the folder structure.

commands.name: menubar-status
commands.title: Repository Health
commands.subtitle: Reponizer
commands.description: Menu bar overview of repositories that need attention.

preferences.name: reposRoot
preferences.title: Repositories Root
preferences.description: Folder containing all repositories, organized as host/owner/repo (git-get layout).

preferences.name: defaultProtocol
preferences.title: Default Protocol
preferences.description: Protocol used when cloning bare paths (e.g. github.com/owner/repo) and when suggesting origin URLs.

preferences.name: scanDepth
preferences.title: Max Scan Depth
preferences.description: How many folder levels below the root to search for repositories. 3 covers host/owner/repo; increase for GitLab subgroups.

preferences.name: networkConcurrency
preferences.title: Network Concurrency
preferences.description: How many repositories Fetch All / Pull All sync at the same time. Higher values finish faster but put more load on the SSH agent (e.g. 1Password) and the network.

preferences.name: hostAliases
preferences.title: Host Aliases
preferences.description: Comma-separated alias=host pairs mapping a folder name under the root to the real remote host, e.g. “buw=git.uni-wuppertal.de, overleaf.com=git.overleaf.com”. Aliases may be any folder name.

preferences.name: hostOnlyHosts
preferences.title: Host-Only Comparison
preferences.description: Comma-separated hosts (alias or real host) whose repos are audited by host only — the folder path below the host may differ from the remote path (e.g. Overleaf’s opaque project IDs).

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Application used by the “Open in Editor” action.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Application used by the “Open in Terminal” action. Terminal.app, iTerm2, kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Warp all open in the repository folder.
